source_of_truth.rule: Modules integrate only through Nexus capabilities/contracts/events/results; no module may depend on another module's private runtime state.

architecture.physical_layout: Existing runtime addons keep authoritative paths; future modules receive reserved addon directories and are activated only after source/config migration gates.
architecture.feature_ownership_rule: Each domain feature has exactly one owning module; consumers integrate through Nexus contracts/capabilities/events and must not duplicate implementation.
architecture.hub_rule: Hub is an optional player-facing integration/orchestration layer. No domain module may require Hub in order to function.

global_after_gate: Only after 0.13-A closes, continue Items 0.13-B JIP & State Reconciliation and begin formal cross-module contracts.

optional_server_provider_model.principle: SP_ORG domain modules remain functional without economy/stock/persistence providers. When providers exist, modules discover them through Nexus and use their contracts.

weapon_identity.decision: WeaponInstance identity and definitive serial belong to Weapons because identity exists independently of whether wear is enabled.
weapon_identity.gate: Prove identity preservation across player inventory, weapon holders, storage and multiplayer transfers before implementation.

weapon_wear.decision: WeaponCondition owns authoritative condition/wear/maintenance logic. Use event-driven counters plus lazy/batched evaluation; no per-frame domain wear loops.
weapon_wear.compatibility_goal: Allow native SP_ORG condition provider or external adapters while keeping a single authoritative provider per weapon/session.

weapon_module_split.weapons: What the weapon is: identity, serial, configuration, compatibility, recipes and dynamic weapon swap.
weapon_module_split.weaponCondition: How the weapon is: usage, wear, environment exposure, parts condition, reliability and maintenance state transitions.
weapon_module_split.armorer: Where/how the player interacts: station, preview, assembly, inspection and maintenance workflow/UI.

organizer_hub.decision: Create optional Hub as the player-facing integration/orchestration layer. Nexus remains technical infrastructure; Hub provides unified navigation, context handoff and cross-module actions without owning domain logic.
organizer_hub.dependency_direction: Hub discovers/consumes modules; domain modules must not depend on Hub.
invariants: Hub coordinates but does not implement domain logic.
Hub shows only modules/features actually available.
Hub may orchestrate cross-module actions but each step is executed by its owning module.
Sets owns persistent composition data; Hub owns the player-facing integrated experience.
Nexus connects modules technically; Hub connects the player to modules functionally.
